notes.title: Update v5.5.5
notes.notes:
Hello guys, I just updated Sponchies!

In this update: 

-I fixed all known bugs
-and I also reworked the wall jumping system... its a lot better now!

Please give it a try and let me know how it is.

I'm sorry that it took me so long to release this little update, but I have been very busy this last few weeks.

notes.title: Sponchies: Update 5.5.0 Final - Bug FREE
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30749945/5c73d73f3eab83811adaec31fb084ae44b882ebb.png

Update 5.5.0 is now live for Sponchies, in this update I crushed all the bugs in the game.

The game is completely bug free now, I had to rebuild the collision system entirely so the Sponchies won't get stuck inside the walls anymore.

The difficulty in many levels was rebalanced, I think is perfect now.

As always if you happen to find a new bug, please let me know so I can fix it.

If you are enjoying Sponchies, please support me by writting a review here in Steam, that really helps! Thanks ːs_happyː

 Edited 10/30/17: ------------------------------------------------------------

 In update "5.5.1" I reworked and improved the wall jump system, hopefully this will help new and keyboard players. 

 Edited 11/01/17: ------------------------------------------------------------

 Update 5.5.3:

-Improved the wall jumping system even more (I think it's perfect now)
-Added wall jumping instructions in LVL 4

http://store.steampowered.com/app/593670/Sponchies/

notes.title: Update v.5.4.8
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30749945/a07b15089ad0f7960d7a02dcd51c693554005eaf.png

Hello guys, I just updated Sponchies and fixed some bugs. 

This is a pretty solid patch, but if you still find any hidden bugs please let me know so I can fix them right away.

If you are enjoying Sponchies, please consider taking a couple minutes of your time to drop a review here on Steam that really goes a long way! I could really use the support.

Patch notes:
-Fixed pause menu, it no longer closes when you open the steam overlay
-In some levels the player was getting stuck inside some canons.
-In some levels the playes was getting stuck inside the walls.
-Fixed collison issues
-Fixed sound & music issues
+ many little tiny bugs.
